newsitem.title: USA: Premier, Becton Dickinson form partnership.
newsitem.headline: Premier, Becton Dickinson form partnership.

text.p: Premier Inc, an alliance of hospital and health systems, said it entered into a multi-year corporate partnership for medical supplies, devices and diagnostic systems with Becton Dickinson and Co.
The seven and one-half year partnership includes group purchasing agreements with prospective sales volume of about $240 million annually.
The agreement, starting April 1, 1997, offers Premier's 1,800 hospital and health system owners and affiliates discounts and incentives on a variety of Becton Dickinson products.

Premier resulted from the merger earlier this year of the former American Healthcare Systems Inc in San Diego, Calif., SunHealth Alliance Inc in Charlotte, N.C. and Premier Health Alliance Inc in Chicago.
